name: The Verdant Canopy
description: The third band of the tower, climbed after the warm Atrium and the cold Spire — a lush glasshouse canopy where the stone gives way to living things: tiered planters of moss, fern-fronds, and hanging vines lit through green glass, with one luminous pod-flower hanging over the path you orient by. This is the CUE-KINDS band: the color->button code is the FAMILIAR Xbox default (blue=X, green=A, red=B, yellow=Y), kept unmutated on purpose — the challenge here is a richer cue VOCABULARY, not a scrambled map. Two new cue kinds arrive. DECOYS are fake-out flashes you must NOT hit (a hit is a fault; the right read is to let it pass) — floor 0 teaches them alone with all four colours. DOUBLES flash TWO colours at once and demand BOTH their buttons inside the window — floor 1 teaches them clean, with no decoys to muddy the read. Floor 2 mixes both kinds so the player must triage fake-outs and twin-presses in the same chart, and the crown floor is a denser mix of all three reads (tap / avoid / press-both). Hero landmark: the Lumen Pod, a fat faceted seed-pod flower of pale-jade glass with a glowing lime stamen that blooms like a lantern of chlorophyll — round and organic where the Atrium's lantern is a hard octa and the Spire's beacon is an angular crystal. Palette + legibility plan: a deep forest-green base (near-black mossy stone and dark canopy shadow) kept dark so the pale-jade pod and the electric-lime accent POP off it (relative-luminance spread far past the 0.3 mush threshold — the dark moss reads as silhouette, the lime stamen as light). DISTINCT from BOTH siblings: the Atrium is fully WARM (amber stone, lantern-gold, golden sky) and the Spire is COLD blue (cobalt/violet stone, cyan beacon, night-blue sky); the Verdant is GREEN-dominant — mossy emerald stone, jade glass, lime light, against a soft green-glass sky — so its mean-palette signature sits far from the warm-amber and cold-cobalt signatures and the three never blend.
